manual.title: AUDAC MTX / M2 / XMP44
manual.description: Default port 5001. Model 'auto' detects MTX, M2 and XMP44 (an MTX is assumed to be an MTX88, pick MTX48 for 4 zones).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check IP/port. Note: AUDAC devices accept only 1 simultaneous connection.
error.no_devices_found: No AUDAC device answered on port 5001 in the local network. Enter the IP address instead (a device already connected to another app does not answer).

abort.not_audac_device: The discovered device is not an AUDAC device
